title: Nighttime Sunwatch
text:
🌕 Nighttime Sunwatch — September 29, 2026

🔆️ Solar activity: Low (B2.4)
🔥 Latest solar flare: C1.5 (Peaked September 29, 2026 at 21:46 UTC)
💨 Solar wind speed: 278 km/s (Calm)
🌎 Geomagnetic activity: Quiet (Kp 1.33)
🚨 NOAA Watch: Geomagnetic Storm Category G1 Predicted

Just as Earth orbits the Sun, the Sun races around the Milky Way at about 500,000 mph. 🌌💫🤍

Several bright active regions and a darker coronal-hole-like feature are visible in today’s solar images, while the outer corona appears routine.

Image: NOAA GOES-19 SUVI — 171 Å
Data: NOAA Space Weather Prediction Center
